en.headline: Observatory forecasts mainly fine Saturday and cloudier Sunday
en.dek: Saturday will be mainly fine and dry by day with temperatures from 25 to 29 degrees, while Sunday brings more cloud and early rain patches.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said an easterly airstream would affect the coast of Guangdong over the weekend, bringing mainly fine weather on Saturday that becomes cloudier at night.

On Saturday temperatures are expected to range from 25 to 29 degrees Celsius, with relative humidity between 55 and 80 per cent. Winds will start light and become east force 4, occasionally force 5. The day is forecast to be dry.

Sunday is expected to be mainly cloudy, with one or two rain patches at first and bright periods during the day. Temperatures will range from 25 to 28 degrees, with higher humidity of 65 to 90 per cent. Winds will be east force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore early in the day.

The Observatory said the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China early to midweek next week, bringing stronger winds and occasional rain. No weather warnings were in force early on Saturday.

zh.headline: 天文台預報周六大致天晴 周日多雲及有雨
zh.dek: 周六日間大致天晴乾燥，氣溫25至29度；周日雲量增多，初時有一兩陣雨。
body: 香港天文台表示，一股偏東氣流會在周末影響廣東沿岸，周六大致天晴，晚上漸轉多雲。
周六氣溫介乎25至29度，相對濕度百分之55至80。風勢初時微風，其後轉東風4級，間中5級，日間乾燥。
周日大致多雲，初時有一兩陣雨，日間部分時間天色明朗。氣溫25至28度，相對濕度較高，介乎百分之65至90。風勢東風4級，初時離岸間中5級。
天文台預期東北季候風會在下周初至中影響華南，風勢較大及早晚有雨。周六凌晨並無天氣警告生效。
